{"name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Convai setup toolset: high-level, idempotent editor operations that wire a
MetaHuman / Pawn Blueprint and the current level up for Convai conversation
and navigation. These replicate the plugin's Content-Browser / context-menu
setup flows so an AI agent can perform them programmatically instead of
hand-editing Blueprint graphs.

All Blueprint paths are package object paths, e.g. "/Game/MyChars/BP_Npc".","tools":[{"description":"Adds the Convai player component to the player's PAWN Blueprint (the controllable character the player possesses) so the
player can speak to Convai characters. Adds BP_ConvaiPlayerComponent if missing,
then compiles and saves. Idempotent.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset.SetupConvaiPlayer","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"playerBlueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the player PAWN Blueprint (the possessed/controllable character that owns the camera + input), e.g. "/Game/FirstPerson/Blueprints/BP_FirstPersonCharacter"."}},"required":["playerBlueprintPath"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string describing what was changed."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Sets up Convai-tuned movement on a character/pawn Blueprint so it can navigate.

If the Blueprint's parent is a plain AActor it is reparented to APawn. A
UFloatingPawnMovement component is added if one isn't present (or inherited),
and Convai movement defaults are applied (MaxSpeed=375, Acceleration=200,
Deceleration=250, TurningBoost=3, plus nav-path-following defaults). For
Character-based Blueprints the inherited CharacterMovementComponent is tuned
with the equivalent walk-speed / nav-agent defaults instead. The Blueprint is
compiled (when safe) and saved. Idempotent.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset.SetupConvaiPawnMovement","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"characterBlueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the character/pawn Blueprint, e.g. "/Game/NPCs/BP_Guard"."}},"required":["characterBlueprintPath"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string describing what was changed."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Turns a character Blueprint into a talking Convai character.

Adds BP_ConvaiChatbotComponent (the convenience chatbot component) and a native
ConvaiFaceSyncComponent if missing; sets the chatbot's CharacterID and enables
bAutoFillConversationPartnerFromPlayer; sets the face-sync LipSyncMode to the
MetaHuman blendshape mode (BS_MHA) with interpolation enabled; and assigns the
Convai MetaHuman face/body anim Blueprints to the skeletal mesh components named
"Face" and "Body". Compiles and saves. Idempotent (re-uses existing components).","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset.SetupConvaiCharacter","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"characterBlueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the MetaHuman/character Blueprint."},"characterId":{"type":"string","description":"The Convai backend Character ID to assign to the chatbot component."}},"required":["characterBlueprintPath","characterId"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string describing what was changed."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Sets ONE property on a Blueprint AND propagates the new value to every already-placed level
instance that still holds the old value (per-instance overrides are preserved). Handles BOTH:
  - a COMPONENT-template property: pass the component's variable name in ComponentName;
  - an ACTOR / Blueprint-level property (a BP variable / CDO property): leave ComponentName EMPTY.

Use this INSTEAD of a raw property set + compile when the change must also reach characters
ALREADY placed in the level. Verified: neither ObjectTools.set_properties nor compile_blueprint
propagate template/CDO edits to already-placed instances (they only affect the template + NEW
instances) — for components OR actor-level properties.

The value is parsed via the property's own text importer, so any type works: "300.0" (float),
"true" (bool), "Hello" (string/name), "(X=0,Y=0,Z=300)" (vector/struct), "/Game/P.A" (object).
Compiles and saves the Blueprint. NOTE: edit through THIS tool from the start — a value already
desynced by a prior raw set looks like a per-instance override and won't be propagated.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset.SetBlueprintPropertyAndPropagate","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"blueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the Blueprint, e.g. "/Game/NPCs/BP_Guard"."},"componentName":{"type":"string","description":"The component's Blueprint variable name (e.g. "ProximitySphere"); leave EMPTY for an actor/BP-level property."},"propertyName":{"type":"string","description":"The property name, e.g. "SphereRadius" (component) or "MyVar" (actor-level)."},"valueAsString":{"type":"string","description":"The new value in Unreal text form (parsed by the property importer)."}},"required":["blueprintPath","componentName","propertyName","valueAsString"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string including how many placed instances were updated."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Spawns a NavMeshBoundsVolume into the current editor level so that Convai
characters can path-find. By default the volume is centered and sized to cover
the combined bounds of the level's actors; pass an explicit Location and Extent
to override. After spawning, navigation is rebuilt.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiSetupToolset.AddNavMeshVolumeForCurrentLevel","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"description":"Optional world-space center for the volume. If unset, the level bounds center is used.","title":"Vector","type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"number"},"y":{"type":"number"},"z":{"type":"number"}},"required":["x","y","z"]},"extent":{"description":"Optional half-extent (cm) of the volume box. If unset, derived from the level bounds (with a margin).","title":"Vector","type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"number"},"y":{"type":"number"},"z":{"type":"number"}},"required":["x","y","z"]}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string including the final volume location and extent."}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
